name: Cash-intensive business
description: Customer's business relies heavily on cash receipts, making revenue difficult to verify against stock, costs or card use.
fp: Many legitimate retail and hospitality businesses are cash-heavy; compare takings to sector norms.

sources.text: FATF, Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach (sector-specific guidance series, general principles)
FATF Recommendations, Recommendation 1 and Interpretive Note (assessing risks and applying a risk-based approach)
Wolfsberg Group, Guidance on a Risk Based Approach for Managing Money Laundering Risks (2006)
WHO FCTC, Protocol to Eliminate Illicit Trade in Tobacco Products (2012)
OECD and EUIPO, public material on illicit trade
World Customs Organization, public material on tobacco smuggling

links.name: Cash-intensive business
